predicate MinOf(elements: list[option[int]], v: int) {
    ((∃(i: int) ::
        (((0 <= i < len(elements)) ∧
            is_some(elements[i])) ∧
            (unwrap(elements[i]) == v))) ∧
        (∀(j: int) ::
            (((0 <= j < len(elements)) ∧
                is_some(elements[j])) ==>
                (v <= unwrap(elements[j])))))
}
